question: Can one explicit conjugation-compatible asymmetric pair of scale rays attach to both Phase-39 scale faces and give uniform exp(-S_2) good scale ends over the already declared finite nonzero-lapse and compact scalar window?
primary_obstacle: scale-factor ends of the finite m=2 local cap over its compact scalar window

ragnarok_boundary.distinct_question: This construction does not rerun or repair Phase 39. It uses the committed exact action to test a new unnumbered asymmetric tail pair outside the finite scale window.

upstream_evidence.role: Frozen m=2 action, finite field window, half-angle cap embedding and finite nonzero-lapse bounds.
Durable local-intersection report that leaves every field face, good end and global-cycle obligation open.
Scoped KILL of the antipodal half-angle scale line; explicitly leaves asymmetric cubic-sector tails open.
Human-readable derivation and claim boundary for the immediately preceding scale-end falsifier.

primary_sources.title: Analytic Continuation Of Chern-Simons Theory
primary_sources.role: Relative-cycle and good-end framework only. With I=-S_2, the exp(-S_2) chain ends must enter Re(S_2) tending to positive infinity. The paper does not supply this model's original cycle.

primary_sources.title: La descente des cols par les onglets de Lefschetz, avec vues sur Gauss-Manin
primary_sources.role: Comparator warning that polynomial Laplace integrals require control of singular behavior at infinity; no complete infinity census is imported here.

primary_sources.title: Periods for rank 1 irregular singular connections on surfaces
primary_sources.role: Comparator for rapid-decay homology requiring compactification and divisor data in meromorphic problems; this local scale-fiber calculation does not claim those data.

declared_conventions.model: equal-endpoint two-segment midpoint Starobinsky configuration action with h=1/2
declared_conventions.finite_window: rho in [1/5,6/5], psi in [-pi/2,pi/2], q=exp(i*psi/2)*y_phi with y_phi in [-1/4,1/4]
declared_conventions.right_tail: for r>=1/4, x=(1/4)*exp(i*beta)+exp(i*alpha_R)*(r-1/4), alpha_R=psi/3-pi/3; a piecewise-smooth corner at the face is permitted
declared_conventions.left_tail: for r>=1/4, x=-(1/4)*exp(i*beta)+exp(i*alpha_L)*(r-1/4), alpha_L=psi/3+pi/3; a piecewise-smooth corner at the face is permitted
declared_conventions.tail_relation: alpha_L-alpha_R=2*pi/3, so both ray cubes equal -exp(i*psi); conjugation exchanges right at psi with left at -psi
declared_conventions.good_end: Re(S_2) tends to positive infinity along r tending to positive infinity
selection_family: the exact Phase-39 compact scalar window only
two explicit asymmetric affine scale rays continuously attached at the two Phase-39 scale faces, with no smooth-tangent claim
the finite nonzero-lapse regulator rho in [1/5,6/5]
no scalar infinity, mixed corner, lapse infinity or zero-lapse limit

controls: Rebuild the exact two-element action for general bounded q and extract its x-cubic coefficient without importing the preceding q=0 reduction.
Prove both declared asymmetric ray cubes equal -exp(i*psi), while their directions differ by 2*pi/3 rather than the antipodal pi of a straight line.
Use phi_boundary>1, |q|<=1/4, sqrt(2/3)>4/5 and a rational lower Taylor bound for exp(7/10)>2 to prove |V(Phi)|<27/16.
Prove the normalized real cubic coefficient on both tails exceeds 9089/960 uniformly on the entire declared finite window.
Verify that the affine outgoing rays meet the two Phase-39 scale faces exactly as a continuous piecewise-smooth attachment and never touch the sole T=0 action divisor.
Record that the remaining coefficients are continuous and bounded on the compact parameter window, so the positive leading margin implies one common sufficiently large tail radius.
Evaluate the original two-element complex action directly at high precision on boundary and central samples without using the extracted cubic polynomial as the numerical evaluator.
Keep scalar infinity, mixed corners, source selection, relative homology, orientation and every global or physical output null.

decision_table.condition: both explicit ray cubes share a strictly positive uniform real cubic coefficient over the full declared finite lapse and compact scalar window, the outgoing rays attach exactly at the scale faces, and independent direct-action controls converge to that coefficient
the declared pair contains a nonpositive leading sector or fails conjugation-compatible attachment on the stated window
the exact uniform bound or independent direct-action controls do not decide the declared pair
